info.desc: Roxy Music is the debut studio album by art rock band Roxy Music. It was recorded on 14 March 1972 – 29 March 1972 at Command Studios, London and released on 16 June 1972. It was generally well received by contemporary critics and made it to number 10 in the UK Albums Chart. Tracklist UK Side one No. Title Length 1. "Re-Make/Re-Model" 5:10 2. "Ladytron" 4:21 3. podcast.body: This self-titled debut album was released on June 16, 1972. It was characterized by its fashionable, glamorous, and artsy approach, incorporating film and cultural references, and venturing into the avant-garde with futuristic and retro, sexy and standoffish, silly and serious elements. Its experimental nature, particularly its heavy reliance on synthesizer on Side Two as noted by a Cream Magazine review in 1973, divided critics but appealed to a segment of British music fans, including future punks. "Their cell titled debut album was released on June 16th, 1972."

podcast.body: This self-titled debut album was released on June 26, 1972, the same day as David Bowie's *The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars*. The band explicitly thanked their hair, makeup, and fashion stylist in the liner notes, signaling their embrace of glam aesthetics. "The band actually thanked their hair, makeup, and fashion stylist in the liner notes."
